purpose: silver_nyc_flights is the cleaned, contract-governed record of 2013 NYC-area flight departures derived from bronze.nyc_flights (166158 rows). It carries one row per scheduled flight leg with typed date parts, scheduled and actual clock times, delays, aircraft tail number, route and distance, feeding downstream on-time-performance and route-level analytics.
usage: Read one row as one scheduled flight leg keyed by year, month, day, carrier, flight, origin and sched_dep_time; time_hour gives the scheduled departure hour as a timestamp with time zone. dep_time, sched_dep_time, arr_time and sched_arr_time are HHMM-packed integers (min 1, max 2400), not minute offsets, so convert them deliberately before arithmetic. Delay and air_time columns are nullable for non-departing or non-arriving legs: filter on is_departure_recorded, or on arr_delay IS NOT NULL, when computing completion or on-time rates so the roughly 3 percent of such rows do not silently skew averages.
limitations: The cleanup is type and naming only: no rows are removed, nothing is imputed, and duplicate_row_rate was 0.0 so no dedupe was applied. Missing operational data is retained as nulls at the rates the profile measured: dep_time and dep_delay 0.029388, arr_time 0.0307, arr_delay and air_time 0.032981, and tailnum 0.009154. The profile shows only year 2013 (distinct_count 1) and months 1 through 6, so the table covers a partial year as landed. carrier, origin and dest codes are not validated against a reference dimension, and the declared grain is a proposal measured from column statistics only and must be confirmed against the warehouse.
